SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY No. D. 9563 Section 11. 3. 32）
Date March 10, 1932.

Subject (in full) Dissension between Chiang Kai Shih and Sun Fo's cliques

Made by Supt. Tan Shao-liang Forwarded by Tho Robertson, Supt.

It will be remembered that shortly after the con-
clusion of peace between Nanking and Canton in Shanghai,
Chiang Kai Shih resigned and Sun Fo and his followers took
charge of the various positions in the Nanking Government.
Owing to the lack of support from the various cliques and
the Shanghai bankers Sun Fo found it impossible to carry on.
He persuaded Wang Ching Wei to re-enter political life and
Chiang Kai Shih followed suit. Sun Fo has since retired
from all his positions and has been confining his efforts
to creating dissatisfaction amongst the southern politicians
and military leaders against the Nanking Government. A
circular telegram recently despatched by him and Eugene Chen
openly denounces the Nanking Government for failing to send
reinforcements to Shanghai thereby causing the retreat of
the 19th Route Army. Sun Fo and Madam Sun Yat Sen are
reported to have financed certain mosquito newspapers in
Shanghai with the object of propaganating against the
Nanking Government. However it is difficult to tell to what
extent Sun Fo's propaganda has influenced the southern
rulers or rulers of Kwangtung. His hesitation to return to
Canton would seem to indicate that he is not altogether
persona grata to General Chen Chi Tang the Military leader
of that province.

Political observers believe that Sun Fo's activities
will not produce the results desired by him and will simply tend
to increase the hostility of the Nanking Government towards
his, Sun Fo's, clique.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处登记处 编号 D. 9563 第11科 1932年3月3日）
日期：1932年3月10日。

主题（全称）：蒋介石派系与孙科派系之间的不和

呈报人：谭绍良督察 转呈人：罗伯逊督察

兹忆及南京与广州在上海达成和平协议后不久，蒋介石辞职，孙科及其追随者接管了南京政府的各个职位。由于缺乏各派系及上海银行家的支持，孙科发现其工作难以为继。他劝说汪精卫重新参与政治活动，蒋介石亦随之复出。此后，孙科已辞去所有职务，并致力于在南方政客和军事领导人中制造对南京政府的不满情绪。他最近与陈友仁联名发出的一份通电，公开谴责南京政府未能向上海派遣增援部队，从而导致第十九路军撤退。据报，孙科与孙逸仙夫人资助了上海的某些“蚊子报”（小型报刊），旨在进行反南京政府的宣传。然而，很难判断孙科的宣传在多大程度上影响了南方统治者或广东统治者。他犹豫是否返回广州，似乎表明他在该省军事领袖陈济棠将军那里并非完全受欢迎。

政治观察家认为，孙科的活动不会产生他所期望的结果，而只会加剧南京政府对他所属的孙科派系的敌意。
